_comment: Contract v1 between the GPU summary API (src/slidebox_api) and the Pi news service (services/news). Canonical example. GPU side: deck_payload() of a fixed Deck must reproduce `result` exactly. Pi side: save_result()/check_speaker_result() must accept `result`; the API substitution tests use it too. Keep the two copies byte-identical.
